name: Farm Fresh
description: A warm, organic storefront LOOK for a fresh-food brand — a styled home, full menu page, brand story, locations, catering and contact pages, a journal, enriched product and blog templates, a matching theme, and brand-voiced welcome + seasonal newsletter emails. The look, not the goods: it ships no catalog of its own, so the product grids fill with your own products (or industry sample data) and are empty until then. Installs as a draft for the tenant to review, customize, and publish.
